limitations: Match holdout does not establish competition or period transfer
Partial observed defenders differ from represented browser scenes
Marginal feature ranges do not prove joint support
Sentinel and extreme keeper positions may be sparsely supported
Coefficients and controlled scenes do not demonstrate causality
Selection bootstrap is exploratory; final test remains unopened
development_evidence.population: male open-play foot shots with observed keeper; partial defenders

selection.consequences: No refit after selection; #13 evaluates this exact pipeline and controls public release
selection.hypothesis: Additional positional groups or nonlinear trees improve probability estimation
selection.rationale: Use simplest reference-improving pipeline competitive under the predeclared paired rules

training_exploration.correlation_population: training rows with at least one observed defender
training_exploration.support_note: Marginal ranges do not establish joint scene support
training_exploration.visibility: partial embedded frames; unseen players not imputed

limitations: Match-isolated holdout measures the represented cohort, not unseen league/period transfer.
Defender observations are partial embedded shot frames; optional 360 coverage is not a test-row covariate.
Missing/multiple keepers are excluded; no valid prediction is obtained by imputing a keeper.
Zero observed defenders do not establish an empty pitch; sentinel support can be absent or extremely sparse.
Support distances are training-only diagnostics, not proof of realistic joint player configurations.
Full-pitch training scenes differ from current marker-safe UI bounds; historical UI audit is descriptive.
Extra attackers, technique, identity, preceding movement and unobserved pressure are omitted.
Controlled responses are within-model comparisons; tree plateaus and nonmonotonic changes can be valid.
Slice/calibration intervals are diagnostic, sparse bins remain uncertain and multiple comparisons are not confirmatory.
Penalties, headers and non-open-play shots are excluded; penalty 0.76 is a separate fixed convention.
StatsBomb supplies Open Data, not this independent model; non-commercial rights/export review and actual-product QA remain required.
population: male open-play foot shots with observed keeper; partial defenders

calibration.review_rule: supported bin residual interval excludes zero

protocol.public_distribution: never authorized by automated evaluation; dated review and #4 production QA required

provenance.historical_compatibility: recorded manifests validated; unchanged scientific semantics checked separately

required_reviews: complete independent reproduction and verification limits
supported calibration/slices and sparse/extreme scene limitations
parameter-only export and current non-commercial distribution rights
dated owner/implementer decision bound to evidence/model hashes
#4 actual product attribution, methodology, production bundles/network assets and #8 final QA

scene_audit.support_method: Training-only standardized retained-feature RMS nearest neighbor; deterministic reference subsample, 99th-percentile leave-one-out threshold. Zero-defender cohort separate; sentinel distance omitted. This diagnostic is not proof of realistic joint scene support or a runtime rejection rule.
